title: OvisOCR3 Technical Report
abstract: arXiv:2610.33066v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We introduce OvisOCR3, a 0.8B model for a broad range of OCR-related tasks. OvisOCR3 unifies document parsing, general OCR, key information extraction (KIE), document figure captioning, and cross-page table reconstruction in a single model. We train the model on real and synthetic data through continued pretraining and use domain-balanced mid-training to balance supervision across tasks with different data volumes and response lengths. Multi-teacher on-policy distillation transfers expertise from five domain-specific 4B teachers into the shared model, followed by mixed-task reinforcement learning with domain-specific rewards. We compare OvisOCR3 with general-purpose vision-language models and specialized OCR models on public and in-house benchmarks covering all five task families. In these comparisons, it achieves an overall score of 96.74 on OmniDocBench v1.6 and the highest overall scores on PureDocBench, Real5-OmniDocBench, and MDPB

translated_abstract: 我们推出了 OvisOCR3，这是一个面向广泛 OCR 相关任务的 0.8B 参数模型。OvisOCR3 将文档解析、通用 OCR、关键信息抽取（KIE）、文档插图描述以及跨页表格重建统一在单一模型中。我们在真实与合成数据上通过继续预训练训练模型，并采用领域均衡的中期训练策略，以平衡不同数据量和响应长度的各任务之间的监督信号。多教师在线策略蒸馏将五个领域专用的 4B 教师模型的专业知识迁移到共享模型中，随后进行带有领域特定奖励的混合任务强化学习。我们将 OvisOCR3 与通用视觉语言模型和专用 OCR 模型在涵盖全部五类任务的公开及内部基准上进行了比较。在这些比较中，它在 OmniDocBench v1.6 上取得了 96.74 的总分，并在 PureDocBench、Real5-OmniDocBench 和 MDPB 上取得了最高的总分。
tldr: OvisOCR3 是一个 0.8B 参数的统一 OCR 模型，通过继续预训练、领域均衡中期训练、多教师在线蒸馏和混合任务强化学习，将文档解析、通用 OCR、关键信息抽取、插图描述与跨页表格重建五大任务集成于单模型之中，并在多项基准测试中取得领先成绩。
en_tdlr: OvisOCR3 is a 0.8B unified OCR model that integrates document parsing, general OCR, key information extraction, figure captioning, and cross-page table reconstruction through continued pretraining, domain-balanced mid-training, multi-teacher on-policy distillation, and mixed-task reinforcement learning, achieving state-of-the-art results across multiple benchmarks.
